function applyAnimationDesc(el, id): void

Defined in: core/utils/a11y/animation-desc.ts:199

Binds an animated element to its translated description — sets the accessible name (alt/aria-label), aria-describedby (+ longdesc on imgs, fallback content on canvases) pointing at a hidden desc node injected into the element's own root.

Safe to call on every mount/locale-change: the desc node is created once per (root, id) and only re-texted afterwards. Elements without a resolvable description are left untouched.

Parameters

el

Element

The animated element (any Element — canvas, img, div, button…).

id

string

ANIMATION_IDS entry naming its animation.

Returns

void
